protocol.layer_selection: Historical final hidden layer 28; preset, no heldout selection.
protocol.target_refit_definition: Fresh scaler and decoder trained only on renamed-shift and opaque-readout rows of the selected TRAIN families. No source rows in these fits.
protocol.budget_interpretation: Number of target training families used by a fresh decoder; a family has 30 labeled target examples. The fixed mixed baseline already used target rows from all 12 training families. These are subset refits, not new data added to that baseline. The ascending family order is fixed, not averaged over calibration-family choices. Semantic-readout has zero training rows.
protocol.selection: All settings preset to original linear/RBF settings; no tuning or validation.
protocol.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit separately on each fit's training rows only.
protocol.inference: Frozen cached vectors; decoder fitting is CPU-only; no GPU/model updates.

bootstrap.statistic: Pooled row metrics after resampling six entire families with replacement.
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on fitted decoders and fixed training subsets; six heldout clusters.
bootstrap.degenerate_intervals: Empirical zero variation can yield [0,0] or [1,1]; not population certainty.
